PMF.BinaryTest: A randomized binary test assigns each observation x a number f(x) between 0 and 1, the probability of rejecting the null hypothesis after observing x.
PMF.BinaryTest.ofEvent: The test associated with an event s rejects the null exactly when the observation belongs to s.
PMF.BinaryTest.ofEvent_apply: For any observation x, the event test has rejection probability 1 if x lies in s and 0 otherwise.
PMF.BinaryTest.tvTest: Given null law P₀ and alternative law P₁, the total variation test rejects exactly those observations x for which P₁(x) > P₀(x). It accepts on ties.
PMF.BinaryTest.rejectProb: On a finite alphabet, the probability of rejecting under law P is ∑ₓ P(x) f(x), the average rejection probability of the test f.
PMF.BinaryTest.rejectProb_mem_Icc: For any randomized test f and law P on a finite alphabet, the probability of rejection lies in [0, 1].
PMF.BinaryTest.size: On a finite observation alphabet, the size of a test f is its probability of rejection under the null law P₀, namely ∑ₓ P₀(x) f(x).
PMF.BinaryTest.power: On a finite observation alphabet, the power of a test f is its probability of rejection under the alternative law P₁, namely ∑ₓ P₁(x) f(x).
PMF.BinaryTest.typeIIError: For a test f on a finite observation alphabet, the type II error is the probability of accepting under P₁. It equals 1 minus the power of f.
PMF.BinaryTest.rejectProb_ofEvent: For an event s in a finite observation alphabet, the test that rejects precisely on s has rejection probability P(s) under law P.
PMF.BinaryTest.typeIIError_ofEvent: For an event s in a finite observation alphabet, the test that rejects precisely on s has type II error P₁(sᶜ), the alternative probability of observing a point outside s.
PMF.BinaryTest.errorSum: For a test on a finite observation alphabet, the error sum adds the probability of a false alarm under P₀ to the probability of a miss under P₁.
PMF.BinaryTest.one_sub_totalVariation_le: Every randomized test of two finite laws P₀ and P₁ has error sum at least 1 − TV(P₀,P₁), where TV denotes total variation distance.
PMF.BinaryTest.errorSum_tvTest: For laws P₀ and P₁ on a finite observation alphabet, the test that rejects when P₁(x) > P₀(x) has error sum exactly 1 − TV(P₀,P₁).
PMF.BinaryTest.isLeast_errorSum: Over all randomized tests of the finite laws P₀ and P₁, the minimum sum of the two error probabilities is 1 − TV(P₀,P₁). This minimum is attained.
PMF.BinaryTest.equalPriorError: For a test on a finite observation alphabet with equal prior probabilities for the two hypotheses, the overall error probability is half the sum of the false-alarm and miss probabilities.
PMF.BinaryTest.isLeast_equalPriorError: For finite laws with equal prior probabilities, the smallest achievable error probability over all randomized tests is (1 − TV(P₀,P₁))/2.
